summary: Barry County, Missouri, fire tower site listed under the Mark Twain National Forest; TopoQuest labels it historical. No source found describes the site today.

evidence.supports: agency is the Mark Twain National Forest
map database lists the feature as Talbert Fire Tower (historical) in Barry County
evidence.quote: Talbert Fire Tower (historical) is a tower located in Barry County, MO
and at an elevation of 1479 ft MSL

evidence.supports: 1966: MDC operated 102 fire towers; the Forest Service operated 43 in Missouri
evidence.quote: In 1966, MDC operated 102 fire towers, and the U.S. Forest Service operated 43 in Missouri.

evidence.supports: towers ranged from 60 to 120 feet; style and elevation depended on cost and site
evidence.quote: Towers ranged from 60 to 120 feet tall, and the style and elevation depended on cost, availability, site elevation, and surrounding topography.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: a Central US Lookouts entry (agency and land description only), a TopoQuest map label and elevation, and the MDC general history of fire towers, which does not mention Talbert. No build date, height, design, staffing, access or fate was found. Status is deliberately not set: the TopoQuest '(historical)' label is the only hint that the tower is gone, and the brief's status stays unknown. Forest Service records for Talbert did not come up in search, so the Mark Twain National Forest's own status and access statement is still missing. The brief's coordinates (36.5872, -93.7678) are consistent with the TopoQuest point (N36.587290, W93.767973).
